title: A cache node dies
headline: The ring reassigned 20.1% of keys vs 80.3% for mod-N, cutting extra origin fetches from 7,844 to 1,949.

title: One page goes viral
headline: Coalescing cut origin renders of the viral page from 187/s to 0.9/s, and hot-page p99 from 190ms to 1ms.

title: The origin slows down
headline: With naive retries the system never recovered after the origin healed (0.0% served); with a retry budget and breakers it recovered in 0.5s (100.0% served).

title: Traffic doubles past capacity
headline: At 2x capacity, goodput was 2,232 req/s with the adaptive limit (p99 38ms) vs 37 req/s without, where the p99 was 299ms.

title: One client floods the API
headline: During the flood, well-behaved clients got 100.0% of requests served with per-client limits vs 1.8% without.

title: Five deploys under load
headline: Five restarts failed 231 requests with stop-then-start and 0 with the socket handoff.
